newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle H1 sales seen up around 17.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nestle H1 sales seen up around 17.5 pct.

text.p: Nestle SA is likely to report first-half sales rose around 17.5 percent, analysts said, down a bit from 18.7 percent growth in the first quarter.
They said Nestle would publish first-half data on Thursday before share trading starts at 0800 GMT, but a company spokesman would not confirm this.

Bank Julius Baer analyst James Amoroso saw sales up 18.1 percent to 33.6 billion Swiss francs ($22.9 billion) on volume growth of 3.3 percent, price hikes of 3.0 percent, acquisitions impact of just under one percent and a currency factor of 10.9 percent.

"We expect sales growth to ease slightly compared with the first quarter to 17.5 percent from 18.7 percent, which reflects the declining currency basis effect," Zurich Cantonal Bank's Patrick Hasenboehler wrote in a research note.
He put volume growth at 2.8 percent, exchange rate impact at 11.3 percent, price increases at 2.6 percent and acquisitions at 0.8 percent.
